news.headline: Nektar Shares Extend Gains as BTIG Reiterates Buy, $178 Price Target After Lilly Verdict
news.summary: Nektar shares rose a further 5.4% on Sept 26 to around $60.75 as BTIG Research reaffirmed its Buy rating and $178 price target, extending the rally sparked by the Eli Lilly jury verdict two days earlier.

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Nektar disclosed new-hire equity inducement grants made outside its shareholder-approved plan, as required under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

news.headline: Nektar Therapeutics awarded $90M jury verdict against Eli Lilly over rezpegaldesleukin dispute
news.summary: A California federal jury found Eli Lilly breached the implied covenant of good faith and fair dealing in its Rezpeg co-development deal with Nektar, awarding Nektar $90 million, well short of the roughly $1 billion sought.

news.headline: Nektar Shares Surge as Investors Cheer Lilly Verdict and Bullish Analyst Targets
news.summary: NKTR shares jumped roughly 15% the day after the $90M Lilly verdict, with the stock trading near $59 as several sell-side analysts maintained double-digit upside price targets.

news.headline: Wedbush Cuts Nektar Price Target to $50 From $80, Keeps Neutral
news.summary: Wedbush lowered its price target on Nektar while maintaining a Neutral rating, citing rezpegaldesleukin safety/discontinuation concerns, just ahead of the favorable Lilly jury verdict.

news.headline: Nektar Enters Quiet Period Ahead of REZOLVE-AA Durability Data
news.summary: Nektar announced a quiet period beginning Sept 8, 2026 running until it discloses 24-week off-treatment durability data from the Phase 2b REZOLVE-AA alopecia areata study, consistent with its practice ahead of prior REZOLVE readouts.

catalysts.label: Post-trial motions / appeal in Nektar v. Eli Lilly
catalysts.detail: A jury awarded Nektar $90M on Sept 24, 2026 for Lilly's breach of the implied covenant of good faith (well below the $1B sought), sending shares up ~15%; the court still must set interest, and the verdict is subject to post-trial motions and possible appeal by either side.

catalysts.label: REZOLVE-AA 24-week off-treatment durability data
catalysts.detail: Nektar entered a quiet period on Sept 8, 2026 ahead of this readout, which will show whether hair regrowth persists after dosing stops in the Phase 2b alopecia areata study.

catalysts.label: Start of registrational Phase 3 alopecia areata study
catalysts.detail: Company-guided timeline reaffirmed in Q2 2026 results, contingent on the REZOLVE-AA durability readout.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD-3 trial initiation
catalysts.detail: Third global Phase 3 ZENITH AD study (treatment-experienced atopic dermatitis patients) guided to start in September 2026, following ZENITH AD-1/AD-2 initiation in July 2026.

catalysts.label: ZENITH AD Phase 3 topline data
catalysts.detail: Initial topline data from the Phase 3 registrational atopic dermatitis program, ahead of a targeted 2029 BLA submission.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 financial results
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly earnings update on cash runway (>$1B as of June 30, 2026) and pipeline progress.

pulse: Nektar's biggest near-term overhang lifted on Sept 24, 2026 when a jury awarded the company $90M against Eli Lilly for breaching their Rezpeg co-development deal (short of the $1B sought, still subject to post-trial motions/appeal). Shares have kept climbing since, up roughly 15% the day after the verdict and a further 5.4% on Sept 26 as BTIG reiterated its Buy rating and $178 price target, even as Wedbush had cut its own target to $50 on safety/discontinuation concerns just before the ruling. Attention now shifts to Q4 2026 REZOLVE-AA durability data (24-week off-treatment) following the company's Sept 8 quiet period, and to the ramping ZENITH AD Phase 3 atopic dermatitis program (AD-1/AD-2 started July 2026, AD-3 guided for September). The company remains well-capitalized (~$1B cash as of mid-2026) but continues to face pipeline execution risk on both the alopecia and dermatitis fronts as it heads toward its next quarterly update.
